record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Fix infinite-dimensional Banach spaces X and Y. Find large families Z of quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals such that (i) Z contains every Lorentz-type ideal d_{r,w}(N0), and (ii) the map z(N0) ↦ LAPP_z(X,Y) is injective on Z.

evidence.quote: Problem 20. Fix any pair of infinite-dimensional Banach spaces X and Y. Find large sets Z of quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals that have the following properties: (1) Z contains all d_{r,w}(N0). (2) The restriction of the map z(N0) → LAPP_z(X, Y ) to Z is one-to-one.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{N}_0 = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$ and let $c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)$ denote the space of real (or complex) sequences indexed by $\mathbb{N}_0$ tending to zero. A quasi-Banach sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is a linear subspace of $c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)$ equipped with a quasi-norm $\|\cdot\|_z$ under which it is complete, such that whenever $a \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ and $b \in c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)$ satisfies $|b_n| \le |a_n|$ for all $n$, then $b \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ with $\|b\|_z \le \|a\|_z$. The ideal is called shift-monotone if, in addition, for every $a = (a_n)_{n\ge 0} \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ the shifted sequence $Sa := (0, a_0, a_1, a_2, \dots)$ belongs to $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ with $\|Sa\|_z \le \|a\|_z$.

For parameters $0 < r < \infty$ and a non-increasing weight $w = (w_n)_{n \ge 0}$ of positive reals with $w_0 = 1$, $\sum_{n} w_n = \infty$, the Lorentz-type sequence ideal $d_{r,w}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ consists of all $a \in c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)$ whose decreasing rearrangement $(a_n^*)$ satisfies
$$\|a\|_{d_{r,w}} := \Big(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (a_n^*)^r w_n\Big)^{1/r} < \infty.$$
Each $d_{r,w}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal.

For a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ and infinite-dimensional Banach spaces $X, Y$, let $\mathrm{LAPP}_z(X,Y)$ denote the operator ideal component consisting of all bounded linear operators $T: X \to Y$ for which there exists a sequence of finite-rank operators $(T_n)$ with $\|T - T_n\| \to 0$ such that the sequence $(\|T - T_n\|)_{n \ge 0}$ belongs to $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, normed in the natural way associated with $z$.

Problem. Fix infinite-dimensional Banach spaces $X$ and $Y$. Identify large families $\mathcal{Z}$ of quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals such that:
(i) every Lorentz-type ideal $d_{r,w}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ belongs to $\mathcal{Z}$; and
(ii) the assignment $z(\mathbb{N}_0) \mapsto \mathrm{LAPP}_z(X,Y)$ is injective on $\mathcal{Z}$ (i.e., distinct ideals in $\mathcal{Z}$ yield distinct operator ideal components).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicitly open problem in a 2023 survey on traces of operator ideals over Banach spaces. No subsequent resolution was found in the search.
